subject_template: Action needed — payment issue on your invoice from {{company_name}}
body_html_template:
Hi {{customer_name}},

We weren't able to process your payment for your recent invoice from {{company_name}}. This can happen when a card expires, has insufficient funds, or the bank blocks the charge.

Retry Payment →

You can retry with the same card or use a different payment method online. No account required.

If you need help or believe this is a mistake, contact us at support@{{company_domain}} and we'll sort it out quickly.

Thank you,
{{company_name}}

Do not reply directly to this email — contact support@pilotfortrades.com for help.
